author: thornewolf
name: Fork-and-Merge Training with Linearized Branch (Late-training SWA)
blurb: Designed: periodic fork into two branches, one trained normally and one against a 2nd-order Taylor surrogate of the loss around the first, merged by averaging. Found: at the only branch-2 LR that keeps phase C stable, branch-2 barely moves, so the merge reduces to plain SWA between fork-start and fork-end checkpoints. 0.020-nat improvement over baseline at matched compute is real but driven by weight averaging, not by the curvature-aware surrogate. Non-record, research/negative-result submission.
